original_direction_rule.question: Does spatial projection preserve propagation within measured core-precedence classes and contact participation?
original_direction_rule.field_axis_scope: Exploratory classification added after inspecting fresh core-precedence results: positive/negative 2D arrival-time rank gradient along the A-B axis; weak/complex fields stay separate. No patient TA/TB assignment or formal equivalence claim.
original_direction_rule.contact_observer: Unchanged observer_firing.json and observer_current_hfo.json, calibrated only on native 9108401.
original_direction_rule.interpretation: Core precedence is measured temporal order, not proof of causal initiation or patient TA/TB identity.
original_direction_rule.evaluation: Contact windows remain the original frozen primary windows. All detected windows and excluded classes remain visible.
original_direction_rule.statistical_unit: Independent external-input trajectory on one fixed topology; events and cross-event pairs are nested descriptive observations.
original_direction_rule.tolerance: Native differences are descriptive references, not prespecified equivalence margins.

field_observer: Original trailing5ms, >=50Hz sustained5ms, omit left-censored cells; rank gradient on physical coreA→B axis. This differs explicitly from A4 late-centroid direction used in the baseline event plot.
scope: Original fixed primary contact windows; all weak, complex and unestimable cases retained. Two native trajectories only; within-direction counts are small, events and cross-event pairs are nested, no equivalence inference.
